svg.title: Three sightings of the same escrow balance
svg.desc: Original Final Vestige Studios documentary evidence diagram. Three Louisiana monthly government reports recorded a claimant application cost escrow balance of 48,087 dollars and 59 cents at March 31 2018, November 30 2019 and September 30 2021. A separate 2026 statutory checkpoint shows that the Bohemia claim processing cost recovery provision remains codified. Equal snapshots do not establish continuous inactivity, a current balance or payments to claimants.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios; created 2026-11-17; rights: original studio graphic, copyright 2026 Final Vestige Studios. Verifiable factual sources: https://jlcb.legis.la.gov/Docs/2018/apr/RTC%20-%20April%202018%20-%20Act%20361%20of%202017%20Monthly%20Report.pdf ; https://jlcb.legis.la.gov/Docs/2019/dec/RTC%20-%20December%202019%20-%20Act%20361%20of%202017%20R.S.%20Monthly%20Report.pdf (printed page 3); https://jlcb.legis.la.gov/Docs/2021/oct/October%202021%20RTC%20Act%20361%20of%202017%20monthly%20report%20-%20September.pdf (printed page 4); https://legis.la.gov/legis/Law.aspx?d=87164 . Visualization, not a historical photograph. Caption: Three reported month-end balances for one DNR claimant-cost escrow, not a continuous bank ledger or royalty payments. Alt: Three dated report cards, 2018, 2019, and 2021, each displaying 48,087 dollars and 59 cents for Bohemia claimant application-cost escrow; current statute is a separate legal checkpoint.
svg.text: Not royalty restitution or a 2026 balance.
FINAL VESTIGE STUDIOS · Original evidence visualization · 2026-11-17
